methods.label: Median and SSS
methods.explanation: \(AB=AC\), \(BD=CD\) (\(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\)), and \(AD=AD\) (common side). The three pairs of corresponding sides are equal, so use SSS.
methods.levelReason: The method combines the Grade 8 definition of a median with the SSS criterion.
